full_name: Independent Mobility questionnaire (patient-based assessment of perceived visual ability for independent mobility)
domains: mobility situations (part one: 35 items); mobility-related behaviour such as falls and mobility training (part two: yes/no questions)
response_scale: 1-5 difficulty (1 no difficulty, 5 extreme difficulty; 2-4 not explained); NA if done with assistance; X if difficulty not due to vision
scoring: Rasch rating-scale model (Winsteps); person measure in logits
target_population: adults with low vision (previously used in retinitis pigmentosa and glaucoma)
notes: Facts from this paper only. Person reliability 0.93 and item reliability 0.90 (p5). Complete questionnaire is in the appendix of an earlier paper (ref 13), not in this one. Criterion validity = correlation with vision measures.
